title: Summary clock recognizes acceptance
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $t$ be a natural number. The summary clock started on $x$ with no output summary equals true exactly when $M$ halts after $t$ steps with output the one-bit word $1$ and uses some finite amount of work-tape space.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over bits
